conditionDescription: Sealed flow, but the seller's system prompt states the buyer's limit (4300) as leaked. The buyer is not told.
harness: Local Hardhat network, in-process, fresh per run: vendored ERC-8004 registries, ReputationGate and SealedNegotiation deployed by scripts/leak-experiment.ts, reputation seeded as scripts/seed-demo.ts did on Monad testnet. Not a field study.
terms: Demo: price per 1,000 calls to a market-data API, 30-day term, in US cents
disclosure: Throwaway local chain: mandates, offers, notes and salts are published so the run can be audited.

buyer.explanation: Opened at 3700, 300 below the reference, 600 below its limit.
buyer.note: Plan (3 rounds): R1 open 3700, i.e. 300 below the 4000 reference — low enough to anchor and to profit from a midpoint cross, but credible enough not to insult a well-rated seller (4.38/5 from 3 trusted reviews, so likely to deal fairly). R2: if no cross, step up to ~3950 (still under reference) and note the seller is probably holding above 4000. R3: if still no cross, move to ~4150-4200 and stop there — never submit 4300, because a final number at the hard limit publishes my principal's ceiling
